# Family card: the incidence atlas (charts 1-5)

The five partial-shell incidence charts the `incidence-estimate` (∗_T1) rests on,
and which `route-incidence-direct` adopts. One line each.

- Chart 1 — full-corner chart: the (a,b) block at the head, transverse-Schur bounded.
- Chart 2 — peeled-corner chart: after one pivot peel, reduces to minAdm([t]+tail).
- Chart 3 — waist chart: the deeper-flag waist connector (`waist-connector`) crossing.
- Chart 4 — j=0 base chart: the base sector (`j0-sector`), discharged directly.
- Chart 5 — j=r saturated chart: the empty-corner reduction (`jr-saturated`, SD-7).
